intake.description: On 23 October 2026, the claimant discovered that two gold bangles and a necklace were missing from a bedroom cupboard in Chennai. A police complaint was filed regarding the missing items valued at approximately Rs 1,50,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-27718 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We do not pay for theft or disappearance of contents where there is no sign of forcible and violent entry into the home.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant reported that gold bangles and a necklace were missing from a bedroom cupboard, but specifically stated that the cupboard and the doors were not broken and nothing else was disturbed. Under clause PROP-EXC-4.4, the policy excludes theft or disappearance of contents where there is no sign of forcible and violent entry into the home. Therefore, the claim is not covered.

flags.fix: The handler must request the police report alongside the other missing property checklist documents, as burglary and theft claims require a police report.
The handler must send a reminder if a requested document has not been received within 3 days of the request. Here, proof of ownership took 5 days to be received without a reminder.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
